experience.subject: Browse your own Emby / Jellyfin / WebDAV / headset video library as a wall of 3D layered posters, then watch on a large screen in a virtual theater with resume, subtitles and audio track selection.
experience.form: Primarily 3D posters with supporting 2D in a Shared Space Volume (Library); Full Space Stage for playback (Cinema).

surfaces.purpose: Main window in Shared Space; TabBar attached above; no recenter or bring-to-front promise
Full Space Stage; dark virtual theater (StageStyle.Full) or dimmed passthrough (Mixed); extent describes the authored theater around the user

actions.purpose: TabBar selection shows Home, Library, Sources or Settings inside the Library Volume; each destination keeps its scroll position and filter when revisited.

Selecting a poster or continue-watching card opens the Details Subwindow beside the Volume and fills it with the selected title (backdrop, name, chips, overview, audio, subtitles, episodes for series). Selecting another title replaces the content without closing.
Closes the Details Subwindow; the Volume keeps its current destination.
Ray, hand-ray or gaze hover tilts the hovered poster up to 8 degrees toward the pointer and widens its layer separation; leaving restores it.
Opens the Full Space cinema Stage and plays the selected title from its saved position (or from 0:00 when none); the Library Volume is hidden while the Stage is open.
Same as enter-cinema but starts at 0:00 and overwrites the saved position as playback advances.
Saves the playback position, closes the Stage and returns to the Library Volume with the Details Subwindow still showing the title.
Toggles play/pause; the button icon and accessible name switch between Pause and Play.
Seeks 15 s back.
Seeks 15 s forward.
Seeks to the slider position and updates the time label.
Sets the playback volume.
Opens the subtitle menu anchored to the subtitle button.
Selects Off, an external SRT/ASS track or an embedded subtitle track; the check mark moves and the screen subtitle line updates or hides.
Opens the system file picker for a .srt/.ass file next to the video; the loaded track is added to the menu and selected.
Opens the audio track menu.
Switches the active audio track; the check mark moves.
Opens the screen size menu.
Resizes the screen to Small 3 m, Medium 6 m or Large 10 m keeping the same visual centre.
On: dark virtual theater (StageStyle.Full). Off: dimmed passthrough room (Mixed).
Opens the language menu (Follow system, Simplified Chinese, English).
Applies the chosen language to every string immediately and persists it.
Sets 3D poster layer separation: Off, Subtle, Standard (default), Strong; posters update immediately.
When on, playback starts from the saved position; when off, from 0:00.
Opens the Clear watch history confirmation dialog.
Removes all saved positions; Continue watching becomes empty; a snackbar confirms.
Finishes the activity and closes all Home Cinema windows.
Opens the Add media source sheet with Jellyfin preselected.
Closes the sheet without saving.
Single choice. Emby/Jellyfin/WebDAV show server, username and password fields; Headset storage hides them and the main button becomes Choose folder.

Authenticates (Emby/Jellyfin AuthenticateByName, WebDAV PROPFIND) or opens the folder picker; on success the source appears in the Sources list and its titles join the library; on failure the field shows an error.
Filters the library grid to All, Movies or Shows.
Opens a search field in the Home header filtering titles by name.
Re-reads all connected sources.

ov.en: A night-shift crane operator keeps a lantern burning for a ship that never arrives, until one foggy winter it finally does.
ov.zh: 夜班吊车司机每晚为一艘迟迟未归的船点灯，直到某个起雾的冬夜，它真的回来了。

ov.en: A sleeper train that only runs under a full moon carries strangers toward the places they forgot.
ov.zh: 一列只在满月夜运行的卧铺列车，载着陌生人驶向他们遗忘的地方。

ov.en: Three siblings return to their grandmother's orchard for one last harvest.
ov.zh: 三兄妹回到外婆的果园，完成最后一次丰收。

ov.en: A small-town radio club picks up a repeating pattern from a nearby star.
ov.zh: 小镇无线电社团收到了来自邻近恒星的重复信号。

ov.en: Four runners carry a message across a desert where every phone has gone silent.
ov.zh: 所有电话都失灵后，四名跑者接力把一封信送过沙漠。

ov.en: Two neighbours who have never met share a window, a rainy season and a playlist.
ov.zh: 从未谋面的两位邻居，隔着一扇窗共享了一个雨季和一张歌单。

ov.en: A retired engineer enters the city kite festival with a kite that refuses to fly.
ov.zh: 退休工程师带着一只怎么也飞不起来的风筝报名了城市风筝节。

ov.en: Two keepers, one island, eight storms.
ov.zh: 两位守塔人，一座岛，八场风暴。
